proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementEligibility
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can record that attunement is required, but not the RAW restriction on who is eligible to attune.

notes: The deterministic mechanics fit honestly as a magic-item activation: held-item gate, 7-charge pool, Fireball charge-cast at levels 3-5 with fixed DC 15, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction. The only omitted rider is the spellcaster-only attunement qualifier.
